_comment: User editor, native emtk window. Drawn by emtk.view_form over UserEditorModel (gui/model.py): 'accounts' is the left window (actions, table, status), 'account' the right one (details, the account form), 'password' the password prompt and 'confirm' the dialog the Qt tool asked with message boxes. The details text is Markdown and the two masked password entries are drawn by gui/app.py (a spec cannot draw either; its 'password' kind is not masked).
title: Users

sections.title: Accounts
sections.name: accounts
sections.description: Every user registered in the MMFDB. Listing them requires an administrator account.
Save or revert the account being edited, fetch the list again, create or delete an account, set a password, copy or export the table.

buttons.label: Save
buttons.description: Write the edited account back to the database. A rename also moves your stored session token, so you stay signed in.

buttons.label: Revert
buttons.description: Discard the edits to this account (asks first).

buttons.label: Reload
buttons.description: Fetch the user list again, in the background.

buttons.label: New
buttons.description: Create a new account. Fill in a username and a display name, then press Save.

buttons.label: Delete
buttons.description: Delete the selected account (asks first). Built-in accounts and the active account cannot be deleted.

buttons.label: Password...
buttons.description: Set or change this account's password. It is applied when you Save.

buttons.label: Copy
buttons.description: Copy the rows the table shows now, with the column headers, to the clipboard as tab-separated text.

buttons.label: Export CSV
buttons.description: Write the rows and columns the table shows now to a CSV file.

sections.description: One row per account. Click a header to sort, click it again to reverse; type in the filter box to keep rows containing the text in any column; right click a header to choose columns. A star marks the account ChiSurf uses for its own database connections.

columns.title: User
columns.tooltip: The display name, or the username when there is none.

columns.title: Username
columns.tooltip: How the account is addressed. Renaming changes it.

columns.title: Role
columns.tooltip: The account's role: free text with a list of common choices.

columns.title: Admin
columns.tooltip: Administrators can manage users and force deletions.

columns.title: Autologin
columns.tooltip: The account may sign in without a password.

columns.title: Active
columns.tooltip: The account ChiSurf uses for its own MMFDB connections.

columns.title: E-mail
columns.tooltip: The contact address (hidden by default; choose it with the column picker).

sections.description: How many accounts were found, who you are signed in as, why an action was refused, and whether anything is unsaved.

sections.title: Account
sections.name: account
sections.description: The selected account's details, one control per row.
Context for the selected account, and any reason it cannot be saved yet.

sections.label: Username
sections.description: How the account is addressed. Changing it renames the account; built-in accounts cannot be renamed.

sections.label: Display name
sections.description: The name shown wherever the user appears.

sections.label: E-mail
sections.description: Optional contact address.

sections.label: Role
sections.description: The user's role. A role stored by a different tool is listed and kept as it is.

sections.label: Affiliation
sections.description: Institution or company.

sections.label: Department
sections.description: Department or group.

sections.label: Phone
sections.description: Optional contact number.

sections.label: Website
sections.description: Optional URL; must start with http:// or https://.

sections.label: Address
sections.description: Postal address.

sections.label: Notes
sections.description: Free-text notes about the account.

sections.label: Administrator
sections.description: Administrators may list, edit and delete users. The server refuses to remove the last one.

sections.label: Allow sign-in without a password
sections.description: Convenient on a single-user machine. Administrators may not use it.

sections.title: Password
sections.name: password
sections.description: Sets or changes the password of the account being edited.
The new password and its confirmation. What you type is shown as stars.
How strong the password is: length, lower case, upper case, a digit and a special character.
What the password still lacks, or why it was refused.
Stage the password or cancel.

buttons.label: Set password
buttons.description: Check the two entries and hold the password until you press Save. Administrators need at least Medium strength.

buttons.label: Cancel
buttons.description: Close this prompt and forget what was typed.

sections.title: Confirm
sections.name: confirm
sections.description: Asks before discarding edits or deleting an account.
What will happen if you confirm.
Confirm or cancel.
